title: Invertibility of the natural hyperplane splitting map
statement: For $N>0$, a finite commutative ring $A$ with $NA=0$, and the normalized twist transport [def-amb-p1-trace], there is a family of hyperplane Chern morphisms $c_S$ over every N-invertible scheme [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class] such that the ordered twisted-unit/Chern map $b_S:A_S(1)[2]\oplus A_S\to Rr_{S,*}A_{P_S}(1)[2]$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] is invertible, and the component square of [lem-sp-finite-p1-kummer-naturality] holds for every morphism of these bases.

proof.text: Choose a map S to the Noetherian N-invertible base U. The map b_U equals the hom of the normalized datum, hence is invertible.

proof.text: The given annihilator N and the public cyclic-coefficient proper exchange theorem, followed by coefficient restriction, make ordinary derived base change invertible. Transport between the ordinary derived and exact derived mates by conjugating the adjunctions; invertible endpoint comparisons preserve invertibility. This proves invertibility of the exchange used in the component square.

proof.text: The source comparison is the isomorphism from preservation of the biproduct followed by the two normalized component isomorphisms. Rewrite the component square and cancel this source isomorphism. This proves b_S invertible.

theorem exists_ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (_hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
          (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S
          ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
            hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) (c S hS) ∧
        IsIso (C := DerivedCategoryModule A S) (ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap A N hA
          (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) S hS (c S hS))) ∧
      ∀ {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
          (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤))),
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A (X := S') (Y := S) f).map (ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) S hS (c S hS)) ≫
          ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A f
            ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (X := ProjectiveLine S') (Y := S')
            (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
            (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA
              (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA)
              (X := ProjectiveLine S') (Y := ProjectiveLine S)
              (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)
              ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
                hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom)).hom =
        ordinaryFiniteP1DecompositionSourceMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) f hS ≫
          ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) S' hS' (c S' hS')
